name: Gyri Reiersen
headline: Co-founder & CPO @Tanso | CDTM | Global Shaper
summary:
With a background as a climate activist and AI researcher, I'm driven by the mission to use technology and innovation to mitigate the escalation of the climate crisis.

In 2021, I co-founded Tanso to support mid-sized industrial companies in accelerating their decarbonization journey. Our TÜV-certified, GRI-aligned, and audit-compliant AI-powered software platform helps companies meet their stakeholder requirements like CSRD, EU taxonomy, and CBAM while enabling strategic climate action through carbon accounting and ESG data management.
Tanso bridges scientific research and key methodologies, be it corporate or product carbon footprint, supports effortless sustainability reporting, and enables strategic control of your company - fit for a resilient future.

Join us in accelerating decarbonization of the industry! https://www.tanso.de/en/karriere

Passionate about using tech to solve society’s biggest challenges, I, prior to Tanso, collaborated with TUM, ETH Zurich, and MIT on research using machine learning to estimate carbon storage in reforestation projects through satellite and drone imagery.

I'm an active member of the Global Shapers Community and other volunteer organizations, and have launched initiatives to empower founders tackling climate change, increase diversity in tech, and break the stigma around mental health.

company.name: Tanso
company.tagline: Carbon accounting & ESG data management software for manufacturing companies
company.description:
Tanso is the ESG and carbon accounting software that industrial companies in DACH rely on to compete and comply in carbon-sensitive sectors. The Tanso platform enables companies to meet customer requests and regulatory requirements in sustainability, ensuring data management to the highest standards through structured, audit-proof processes. With TÜV Rheinland-certified methodology, Tanso is trusted by over 300 industrial customers across automotive, mechanical engineering, food and chemicals to strengthen their competitive position in sustainability and ESG performance.

More information about Tanso: www.tanso.de
